metadata.description: The portable OS-patching process — the definition BOTH engines share (blue today, green tomorrow). Names no engine: this is what org policy gates, what schedules reference, what compliance reports against, and what any provider must satisfy to declare `execute_workflows / Process.OSPatch`.

inputs_schema.description: The typed parameters the run accepts (a declarative JSON-Schema for the run's inputs).

outputs_schema.description: The typed results the run publishes (E2 — every engine must satisfy it).

idempotency.description: Re-run semantics — a bounded codelist (PVD-001 form b), fixed semantics not a growing vocabulary.

compensation.description: What undo means, if anything — a bounded codelist. Rollback is a DIFFERENT process type, declared honestly.

affected_entities.description: Which records this run may mutate — the blast-radius declaration (references).

targets.description: The hosts to patch — references to Compute.* hosts or a DCMGroup (refines the Base inputs).

patch_policy.description: What to patch — a bounded codelist (PVD-001).

reboot_policy.description: Reboot behaviour — a bounded codelist; `if-required` may reference a maintenance window.

exclusions.description: The org's known-fragile packages to hold back.
